intro: Clip Courier is Twitch-only. Its main path is simple: a viewer uses !clip, Streamer.bot creates the last 30 or 60 seconds, and Clip Courier posts that one clip to Discord. Automatic discovery is optional and accepts only clips made during the observed current stream.

sections.title: 1. Turn on !clip delivery
sections.description: Import the package and finish Discord setup before enabling.
sections.notice: The imported !clip command starts disabled. Review it, choose 30 or 60 seconds in its Create Clip action, enable the command, and keep Deliver triggerless.

sections.title: 2. Optional automatic discovery
sections.description: Send Twitch clips made by any normal clipping method during this stream.
sections.notice: Recommended first setup: leave this off and test !clip. When enabled, Clip Library Cache checks public clip metadata, but Clip Courier accepts only timestamps inside the observed Twitch stream session. It never posts older library clips.

sections.title: 3. Write the Discord post
sections.description: Use the available clip tokens in a short message.
sections.notice: Available tokens: {title}, {creator}, and {url}. For !clip, creator is the viewer who used the command. Discord mentions are disabled even if a clip title contains mention text.

sections.title: 4. Optional Discord forum tags
sections.description: Shown only when Discord forum is selected.
sections.notice: Enter one numeric Discord forum tag ID per line. The webhook itself must have been created for that forum channel.

sections.title: 5. Confirm the safety boundary
sections.notice: The webhook remains only in Streamer.bot's Deliver action and is never copied into Wizard settings, exports, logs, or the add-on package. Stable clip IDs prevent duplicate posts; bounded public metadata and confirmed Discord IDs are retained locally.
